metadata.description: Candidate event sources, ticketing hubs, and community calendars detected by Scout AI, QC AI, and Quarantine AI during web operations, awaiting Curator approval to be promoted into mandatory Scout targets.

discoveredSources.name: Arts Club Theatre Company
discoveredSources.focus: Live plays, musicals, and staged comedies across 3 Vancouver stages
discoveredSources.targetBudgetTier: <= $50 CAD (rush, preview, and youth ticket programs)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Largest theatre company in Western Canada; offers sub-$50 preview/rush tiers.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'HEIST by Arun Lakra' at Arts Club Theatre Company (Stanley BFL CANADA Stage)

discoveredSources.name: The Improv Centre (Granville Island)
discoveredSources.focus: Granville Island comedy shows 5-6 nights a week ($20-$33.50 all-in)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Perennial theatre on Granville Island using Spektrix ticketing.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Deadly Dinner Party' at The Improv Centre

discoveredSources.name: The Cinematheque (Downtown Independent Cinema)
discoveredSources.focus: 35mm film retrospectives, international cinema, documentary screenings ($14 CAD)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Downtown Vancouver's essential repertory and archival cinema on Howe St.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Harakiri (1962, Kobayashi Masaki on 35mm)' at The Cinematheque

discoveredSources.name: Firehall Arts Centre
discoveredSources.focus: Contemporary Canadian drama, experimental theatre, and cultural dance
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Historic firehall turned performing arts center in Downtown Eastside.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Red Demon (Firehall Arts Centre & rice & beans theatre)' at Firehall Arts Centre

discoveredSources.name: Diwali Fest (Diwali Celebration Society)
discoveredSources.typeLabel: Annual South Asian Arts & Culture Festival
discoveredSources.focus: Diwali performances, South Asian classical music, dance, rangoli workshops
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Major Metro Vancouver cultural festival celebrating South Asian arts.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Diwali in Vancouver: Mehfil at Roundhouse' at Roundhouse Community Arts & Recreation Centre

discoveredSources.name: Orange Tickets Canada
discoveredSources.focus: Metal, punk, underground rock concerts at Rickshaw and live venues
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Primary ticketing partner for underground metal & punk shows at The Rickshaw.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'FABIO FRIZZI performing the FRIZZI2FULCI concert' at Rickshaw Theatre

discoveredSources.name: Latincouver (The Latin American Plaza in BC)
discoveredSources.focus: Latin American festivals, Día de los Muertos, music & heritage workshops
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Primary cultural hub for Vancouver's Latin American community.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Catrinas Procession: Día de los Muertos' at Gastown Historic District (Abbott & W Cordova St)

discoveredSources.name: Tightrope Impro Theatre (Ticket Tailor Portal)
discoveredSources.focus: Weekly unscripted comedy, narrative improv, and drop-in jams ($26.25 all-in)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Recently relocated to 1330 Napier St in East Vancouver.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Murder She Improvised' at Tightrope Impro Theatre

discoveredSources.name: Commercial Drive Business Society (BIA)
discoveredSources.focus: Italian Day, Halloween on The Drive, holiday parades, community concerts
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: BIA for East Vancouver's historic Commercial Drive cultural strip.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'Halloween on The Drive: Trick'r Treat Parade' at Commercial Drive BIA (Venables St to 13th Ave)

discoveredSources.name: AdmitOne Ticketing (Vancouver Live Music)
discoveredSources.focus: Independent live music, touring bands, club shows (The Biltmore, etc.)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Major direct ticketing partner for The Biltmore Cabaret and indie venues.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Audited 'BUZZ KULL & KONTRAVOID Live at The Biltmore' at The Biltmore Cabaret

discoveredSources.name: Vancouver Writers Fest
discoveredSources.typeLabel: Premier Literary Festival & Year-Round Reading Series
discoveredSources.focus: Author conversations, poetry bases, literary cabarets, and youth writing workshops across Granville Island
discoveredSources.targetBudgetTier: <= $50 CAD & free ($28 regular / $12-$15 youth / free community events)
discoveredSources.potentialYield: High (90+ festival events, monthly Incite series)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Vancouver's flagship literary festival; uses Showpass ticketing with extensive sub-$50 pricing tiers and PWYC digital offerings.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Scouted 'The Poetry Bash' at Performance Works

discoveredSources.name: Vancouver Poetry House
discoveredSources.typeLabel: Spoken Word, Slam Poetry & Community Showcase
discoveredSources.focus: Weekly Vancouver Poetry Slam, Wordplay youth workshops, and VerseFest community poetry events ($10-$15 CAD)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Long-running community arts organization producing Vancouver's weekly poetry slam; outstanding sub-$20 accessible culture.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Scouted Vancouver Writers Fest Poetry Bash partners

discoveredSources.name: Turntable Tickets (BC Jazz & Acoustic Venues)
discoveredSources.focus: Direct box office and table reservations for Frankie's Jazz Club and BC acoustic music venues
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Primary reservation and ticket checkout partner for Frankie's Jazz Club; provides direct table seating selection.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Scouted 'Samuel Bonnet Trio: The Slow Tour' at Frankie's Jazz Club

discoveredSources.name: OpenDate Ticketing (Hollywood Theatre)
discoveredSources.focus: Live concerts, film retrospectives, comedy, and Q&A screenings at Hollywood Theatre
discoveredSources.targetBudgetTier: <= $50 CAD ($15 - $35 CAD regular film & indie gigs)
discoveredSources.curatorNotes: Direct digital ticketing partner for Hollywood Theatre on West Broadway; provides clear fee disclosure and tier breakdown.
discoveredSources.discoveredVia: Scouted 'Ginger Snaps 35mm Screening + Live Q&A' at Hollywood Theatre
